package.name: kin5axcam
package.description: Five-axis milling for the CAM workbench. A 3D Surface (5axis) operation lays a zigzag over the parameter space of one face, cut with any shape of tool, with the tool standing up or pointing along the surface normal leaned over by two angles; every cutting move carries the axis of the tool as I, J and K. A postprocessor writes that vector for a control with TCP, or hands the path to the kin5ax solver and writes the five axes of a real machine. The machine itself can be put in the document, read from a kinematic chain file, and the job played on it: every location solved, the collisions named and shown, and the stock cut away as the tool passes.

workbench.description: Adds the commands CAM_Surface5Axis, CAM_Kin5axMachine and CAM_Kin5axSimulate to the CAM workbench. It is not a workbench of its own: there is nothing to select in the workbench list, and the commands appear once CAM is open.
